edges: The Skylark lands on Crane's Field.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Dick Seaton's marriage to Dorothy Vaneman is solemnized by the Kondalian monarchy.
Martin Crane's marriage to Margaret 'Peg' Spencer is solemnized by the Kondalian monarchy.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne leaves the Skylark by parachute near Earth.
Dick Seaton is engaged to Dorothy Vaneman.
They obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
Prince Dunark is in a relationship with Princess Sitar.
Dick Seaton finds allies in Prince Dunark and his consort Princess Sitar.
The Skylark returns to Earth laden with jewels, platinum, radium, and Element X.
Dick Seaton and Martin Crane rescue Margaret 'Peg' Spencer along with Dorothy Vaneman.
Dick Seaton is declared nominal 'Overlord' of Kondal by the Kondalian monarchy.
They obtain Element X from an outcrop on an Earthlike exoplanet.
